motivation: Small TV and mean distortion do not by themselves qualify rare tails or variances; audit both before promoting a probability codebook.
adversary: Two-state prior rare mass1e-12 and future likelihood [1e-10,1]; evaluate amplification without changing original codebooks.
additional_representation: 12-bit fixed-log-relative-square-root-amplitude codebook, span512 binary amplitude exponent units, zero reserved for impossible states; out-of-domain dynamic range rejects.
coordinate_reason: Bounded quantization error in log amplitudes controls oscillation of the log density ratio, which is unchanged by a common likelihood and nonexpansive under a common Markov transition.
data_policy: Reuse frozen dictionary and existing held-out inputs. This follow-up is designed after primary outcomes; it is a separate prospective audit, not retroactively preregistered primary evidence.
lifetime_limit: An additive distortion ledger is not a uniform-in-time bound; fixed precision alone does not prove ten-year stability.
